items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The interviewer mentions Dink Johnson and the Spikes Brothers, and the interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote or confirmation of a direct relationship.

ctx.x: Dink Johnson. Yeah. Dink Pat his feet so loud, we got a pillar, and then we stood up on a pillar, and the pillar wouldn't do so we got a mattress.
